claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was -3.4 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -10.3 to +3.4). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Content negative reviews rose by 6.27 percentage points in the window.
Off-topic negative mentions dropped by 0.22 percentage points in the window compared to baseline.
The share of new players writing reviews dropped to 3.32% in the window from 5.14% in the baseline.
Total reviews in the window reached 722.

report.summary: Total reviews in the window reached 722. Content negative reviews rose by 6.27 percentage points in the window. Off-topic negative mentions dropped by 0.22 percentage points in the window compared to baseline. Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was -3.4 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch, with a 90% range of -10.3 to +3.4, and the share of new players writing reviews dropped to 3.32% in the window from 5.14% in the baseline. The patch and a price change or sale are inconclusive. Off-topic reviews or a review bomb, a change in who reviewed, and noise or seasonality are ruled out.
